title: Seaside Vacation Rental Near Beach Access & Pools Sleeps 8
meta_description: 3BR Seaside vacation rental for 8 near East Ruskin beach access with two king suites, resort amenities, and luxury coastal comfort.
description_expanded: A Beautiful Day | Luxury Vacation Rental in Seaside, FloridaWelcome to A Beautiful Day, a completely reimagined luxury vacation rental in the heart of Seaside, Florida, on Scenic Highway 30A. Extensively renovated from top to bottom in 2026, this three-bedroom, three-bath Seaside beach home comfortably sleeps up to eight guests and pairs the charm of Seaside architecture with sophisticated new interiors, designer furnishings, and elevated coastal style. Featuring two king suites, a private third bedroom with two queen beds, an all-new designer kitchen, dedicated dining room, spacious living area, and signature screened porch, A Beautiful Day offers an exceptional setting for a luxury beach vacation on 30A.Luxury Seaside Vacation Home Just 194 Feet from Private Beach AccessOne of the home’s greatest advantages is its exceptional location. A Beautiful Day is just 194 feet from Seaside’s private East Ruskin Pavilion beach access, making it easy to walk from your vacation home to the sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters of the Gulf of Mexico. The home is also within easy walking distance of Seaside Central Square, where guests can explore more than 40 boutiques, restaurants, cafés, food trucks, entertainment venues, and the iconic Seaside Amphitheater. With the beach and town center both nearby, guests can experience much of Seaside without needing a car.Screened Front Porch for Relaxed Seaside LivingThe home’s inviting screened front porch captures the relaxed spirit of a Seaside vacation. Comfortable lounge seating includes a large sofa, chaise lounge, club chair, and a distinctive hanging twin day bed. Start the morning with coffee, settle in for an afternoon nap, or enjoy an evening drink while feeling the coastal breeze. It is a peaceful place to slow down and enjoy the sounds of the Gulf just minutes from your door.Completely Renovated Interiors with Designer FurnishingsInside, A Beautiful Day has been thoughtfully redesigned with designer furnishings, curated coastal décor, and a bright open floor plan. The spacious living room features a large central sofa, four swivel club chairs, and a wall-mounted Smart TV with Sonos soundbar, creating a comfortable gathering space for family movie nights or relaxing after a day at the beach.A raised roofline adds character, volume, and natural light, while a newly added rear extension creates a dedicated dining room surrounded by windows. The dining area seats six and overlooks the landscaped yard, creating an inviting space for meals and conversation.All-New Designer Kitchen with Sub-Zero Refrigerator and Quartz IslandThe heart of this Seaside vacation home is the all-new designer chef’s kitchen, designed for both entertaining and everyday beach-house living. Custom cabinetry surrounds a large quartz island with bar seating for five, while new appliances include a four-burner gas cooktop, large double-door Sub-Zero refrigerator, and under-counter microwave. Generous counter space and a well-equipped collection of cookware make it easy to prepare everything from a quick breakfast before the beach to dinner for the entire family.Three Bedrooms and Three Bathrooms | Sleeps 8 in SeasideA Beautiful Day offers three private bedrooms and three full bathrooms, providing comfortable accommodations for up to eight guests and an ideal layout for families, couples, or groups traveling together.The front king primary suite features a king bed, built-in reading lights, a custom built-in dresser, closet space, and a wall-mounted Smart TV. Its private ensuite bathroom includes a marble vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower with a large rain shower and handheld shower wand.The second king primary suite is located at the rear of the home just off the kitchen. This comfortable retreat features a king bed, built-in reading lights, custom shelving with convenient charging stations, closet space with a built-in dresser, and a large wall-mounted Smart TV. The private ensuite bathroom includes a marble vanity and glass-enclosed tub and shower combination with a rain shower feature.The newly added third bedroom is tucked privately behind a sliding pocket door and accessed by a staircase, creating a separate space that is especially well suited for children or additional guests. The room features two built-in queen beds with integrated shades, a large wall-mounted Smart TV, and its own private ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Bikes, Outdoor Shower and Added Vacation AmenitiesAdditional amenities make A Beautiful Day especially convenient for a 30A beach vacation, including two bicycles for pick up at Seaside Transit, a bike rack with space for four bikes, a full-size washer and dryer, outdoor rain shower, Smart TVs throughout the home, and a shared outdoor charcoal grill with the rear guest home.Need More Room? A Beautiful Day has a guest home at the rear of the property that sleeps 4 more. Check out Sunrise.*5 night minimum stay in Spring & Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,558 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceOne-minute walk (194 feet) to private beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion, home to the largest stretch of private residential beaches on 30ASonos surround sound system with speakers throughout the living, dining, and kitchen areasYou Tube TV throughout the homeOutdoor shower for rinsing off after the beachShared charcoal grill conveniently located along the footpathStackable washer and dryer Peacock Alley Premier Linen Partner – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels, sheets, and coverlets throughout the homeAccess to three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking & Policies: Two parking passes issued; a golf cart is considered a vehicle. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; medical or special circumstances require a permitted exception. No pets allowedSTR23-002132
